____rvmn: On Day 9, Pavel Rvmn arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

Pavel Rvmn did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Pavel Rvmn fired back. Teodor Bangarang was grazed. After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Pavel Rvmn helped stack spare sandbags at R-R2. Nobody asked when they would be needed. A letter from home found Pavel Rvmn before the night shift. Pavel Rvmn folded it small and kept it close.

The sergeant at R-R2 called out a range and a spot. Pavel Rvmn was the only one who hit it. Dietrich "Tin" King was grazed. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Pavel Rvmn is number 980. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech.
agiraffedog: Otto "Ghost" Agiraffedog reported to S-S10 with a bullet that missed him sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
The dugout roof dripped into Otto "Ghost" Agiraffedog's mug. He moved the mug. The roof found another way.
The machine gun jammed at the worst moment. Otto "Ghost" Agiraffedog cleared it with a bent nail and words the chaplain pretended not to hear.
A bucket appeared above the Hegemony parapet at the Brickworks. Otto "Ghost" Agiraffedog fired. Norbert "Ash" Kkrogheemil pulled the bucket down. Later a sign went up: 'Water costs enough already.'
Otto "Ghost" Agiraffedog shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter.

A single shot from across the wire hit Otto "Ghost" Agiraffedog in the thigh at S-S10. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Dietrich Emfrulla of the Hegemony (@emfrulla). Otto "Ghost" Agiraffedog was hit at S-S10 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Dietrich Emfrulla of the Hegemony (@emfrulla).
The papers connected Marek "Brick" Agiraffedog to Otto "Ghost" Agiraffedog. The men took longer to learn Marek "Brick" Agiraffedog's own habits, but they made the effort.

A man asked Marek "Brick" Agiraffedog to describe Northwick without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch. The clerk counted the names twice. Marek "Brick" Agiraffedog is number 401 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand.
aki_pejo01: By the time Ivo Pejo reached S-C6, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

Ivo Pejo moved to a new hide at S-C6 before dawn, because the old one had been too lucky. The first shot from the new one found Emil Awan, grazed. Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Ivo Pejo could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Benedikt Johnson of the Concord threw a tin of tobacco into the Hegemony trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Ivo Pejo kept the tin. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Ivo Pejo is number 820. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech.
baronpapas_hobbybunker: Rafael "Smokes" Hobbybunker arrived on Day 9 as a replacement. The men in Q-F13 had been fighting for 9 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

Rafael "Smokes" Hobbybunker was hit in the forearm at Q-F13. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Rafael "Lucky" Airsoft of the Concord (@brouwer_airsoft). Victory at Blackwater Canal. Rafael "Smokes" Hobbybunker let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
The medics cleaned Rafael "Smokes" Hobbybunker's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at Q-F13.
cameron_sully: Emil Sully walked into T-F18 on Day 9 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Emil Sully wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Rafael Lm (Hegemony) watched Emil Sully (Concord) drag a wounded man back across no man's land at Sorrow Copse, and held fire until both were gone.
charles_cvr_reyes: Karel Reyes joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
Blackwater Canal is lost. Karel Reyes heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Karel Reyes began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Karel Reyes answered to number 914.
dobremateiconstantin: Walter "Mole" Dobremateico found a place in S-S17 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
Walter "Mole" Dobremateico tried to remember the price of a loaf in Dunmarrow. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought.

A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Walter "Mole" Dobremateico aimed a step ahead and fired: Wendel "Brick" Chickenmcnug, badly wounded. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Walter "Mole" Dobremateico stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

During a lull at the Chalk Pits, Walter "Mole" Dobremateico called across from the Concord line. Walter Goggles answered from the Hegemony side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet. Walter "Mole" Dobremateico got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 599. The men who came later will ask about it.
dreamskyi53736363: Edmund Dreamskyi took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Edmund Dreamskyi did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Edmund Dreamskyi dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Edmund Dreamskyi answered to number 926.
giannismg6: The new sniper gave his name as Gideon Giannismg. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Gideon Giannismg helped stack spare sandbags at R-C3. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Felix Landon and Gideon Giannismg divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion. Gideon Giannismg got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 783. The men who came later will ask about it.
henrialexandrow: Valentin Henrialexand walked into S-S14 on Day 8 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.

Valentin Henrialexand took the long way round Sorrow Copse because the short way had a sniper on it. The long way had two. Mail came up the line with a letter for Valentin Henrialexand. Valentin Henrialexand read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Valentin Henrialexand helped stack spare sandbags at S-S14. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Valentin Henrialexand mended the hole in Tobias "Brick" Blakeg's trousers with fishing line and a bent pin. Brick says the patch is stronger than the trousers. The clerk counted the names twice. Valentin Henrialexand is number 525 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand.
hunter_dorf0629: Konrad Dorf arrived on Day 6 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Konrad Dorf changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument.

Konrad Dorf borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing. A letter from home found Konrad Dorf before the night shift. Konrad Dorf folded it small and kept it close.

Konrad Dorf has asked three carrying parties for the next instalment. So far, the search has produced racing results and an advertisement for boots. A letter from home found Konrad Dorf before the night shift. Konrad Dorf folded it small and kept it close.

Konrad Dorf went over with the raiders and dropped into the Concord trench. Matthias Mart was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@frank_mart00) Konrad Dorf threw a bomb into a Concord dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Karel Pavla was down and screaming for a medic. (@pavla.9_) Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Konrad Dorf could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable. A letter from home found Konrad Dorf before the night shift. Konrad Dorf folded it small and kept it close.

Konrad Dorf read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing. Konrad Dorf got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 451. The men who came later will ask about it.
industriousbear: Day 9. The corporal put Matthias "Saint" Industriousb beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Matthias "Saint" Industriousb went over with the night raiders, found the enemy trench empty at that spot, and came back with a bag of their biscuits. A bullet hit Matthias "Saint" Industriousb's belt buckle at Q-F13 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Emil Sup of the Concord (@sup.0452). The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Matthias "Saint" Industriousb did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Matthias "Saint" Industriousb's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at Q-F13 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
newnario: On the way to R-F17, Viktor Newnario tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
The Concord took Verdel Ridge. Viktor Newnario watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Dawn watch. Viktor Newnario put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram, grazed.
The party came back from Sorrow Copse by different routes. By dawn, everyone had been accounted for except Viktor Newnario.

The missing report was still on the desk when Viktor Newnario walked in. The clerk crossed it out hard enough to tear the paper. Victory at Hill 304. Viktor Newnario let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Viktor Newnario added a leak above the man's head in pencil.
Viktor Newnario and Clement Jewnipers carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident.
Viktor Newnario washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation.
Viktor Newnario tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.

Viktor Newnario was on the dawn watch at R-F17 when the Concord raiders came. A club, a shout, and Viktor Newnario was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Yann Mixtapethepy of the Concord (@mixtapethepyromancer). Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Viktor Newnario helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Viktor Newnario no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Viktor Newnario is number 144. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech.
schutze.neumann_: Benedikt "Mole" Neumann, a choir singer from Tannenfeld, was sent forward on Day 10 to fill a gap in T-F6. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

Someone in T-F6 asked Benedikt "Mole" Neumann about Tannenfeld. He talked for an hour. Nobody interrupted. A letter from home reached Benedikt "Mole" Neumann before dusk. Benedikt "Mole" Neumann read it twice and slept a little easier.
slim_seif: Clement Seif walked into R-R10 on Day 9 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.

The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Clement Seif helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly. A letter from home reached Clement Seif before dusk. Clement Seif read it twice and slept a little easier.
A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Clement Seif lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing.
the_ghost_of_sky: Severin Sky arrived at R-F9 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam corrected the cap; the first puddle corrected the rest.
Felix Varsikasikra taught Severin Sky to play the harmonica. The bay has asked them both, formally, to stop.
Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Severin Sky stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Severin Sky got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.

Severin Sky had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Jonas Miked crossed it, Severin Sky fired. Jonas Miked was badly wounded. A shell landed square in R-F9. They found Severin Sky alive under the sandbags, barely. Every minute counts now. Severin Sky died at his post at R-F9 when the dugout roof came down under a direct hit.
The House of Sky sent Casimir Sky after Severin Sky. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.

Casimir Sky washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation. The Hegemony flag went up over Hill 304. Casimir Sky did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
A bullet went through Casimir Sky's sleeve at R-F9 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Zeno "Ghost" Kattawar of the Concord (@max.kattawar).
A single shot from across the wire hit Casimir Sky in the thigh at R-F9. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Matthias Mart of the Concord (@frank_mart00).
There was never a bed for Casimir Sky, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to R-F9 on his own feet.
A flare lit Hill 304 like noon. Casimir Sky counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.

At R-F9 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Casimir Sky turned around and took a shovel blow. Isidor Liamroberts of the Concord was already gone. Raider: Isidor Liamroberts of the Concord (@liamroberts141). Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Casimir Sky could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Casimir Sky is whole again, or near enough for the line. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Casimir Sky answered to number 102.
vitocarcioppolo: Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp arrived on Day 4 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp kept watch so that Norbert Seamus could sleep. Then Norbert kept watch so that Mole could. Neither slept. Mail came up the line with a letter for Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp. Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at S-F19 is closed now. A clear shot from S-F19. Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp grazed Norbert Cheese and slid back down below the parapet. Hill 304 is lost. Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Leopold Moodie fixed the strap on Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful.
Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.
The section held a competition for the worst joke. Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp won before reaching the end of his entry.

Twenty yards of mud, one gap in the wire, one jump. Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp landed next to Arno Dick in the Hegemony trench. Only Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp climbed back out. (@dick_j0b) Nobody heard the Hegemony raiders cut the wire. Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp only heard boots on the duckboards at S-F19, then nothing but pain. Raider: Albin Weyer of the Hegemony (@wout.vd.weyer). The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp rejoined the squad at S-F19. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp answered to number 254.
xoromevert: Clement "Saint" Xoromevert came up on Day 10 carrying news from Halden. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired. Orders came through: Clement "Saint" Xoromevert is a machine gunner now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a stub of a pencil.

The mud froze hard overnight. For one morning Clement "Saint" Xoromevert could walk on top of it, like a man walking on water. A letter from home found Clement "Saint" Xoromevert before the night shift. Clement "Saint" Xoromevert folded it small and kept it close.
